title: Natural Bodybuilding is dead, but we can revive it
summary: Part 2 of the pro bodybuilding series and a manifesto for the channel. NH argues natural bodybuilding is dead and must separate itself from the enhanced world. He says to starve fake natties of attention rather than feed drama, stick to the truth, focus on yourself, and never buy programs or supplements. He also explains why he comments on enhanced channels, his straight-edge stance and his promise never to lie or sell anything.
claims: Natural bodybuilding has been dead for a long time; those who say otherwise have not accepted the loss
He created the channel about a year earlier to promote natural bodybuilding; if YouTube Fitness were healthy he would not have bothered
Naturals need to separate completely from enhanced communities, because enhanced leadership produces body dysmorphia, mediocre natural physiques, despair and a business of misery
Call-outs and natty-or-not drama do not work: they are the enemy's methods, any attention is good attention, and the target gets to play the victim
Natural creators who call people out often get addicted to the attention and lose their integrity to the system
To destroy the system you must be high up in it, but by then you no longer want to; the only way is to stop giving it attention
Criticism based on truth is not negativity; when someone is truly toxic, go for the jugular, but only engage if you can fully destroy the target
Moral relativism and the sheer number of fake natties let obviously enhanced creators claim natty with a smile
Starve fake natties of attention; they always fade because audiences grow wiser, so natural bodybuilding wins with patience
Stick to the truth and logically sound arguments; liars persist because obsession works, like gaslighting
He respects pros for sacrificing themselves, but many are young men trapped in an abusive relationship with PEDs and an industry that hides the side effects
Most young men who die from PEDs die forgotten; saving one teenager from that path makes the channel worth it
If he stops lifting he can still live a happy life; pros have sacrificed their future
70s and 80s icons like Arnold did more damage to young men's mental health than today's pros, because today's pros are too big to be relatable
The 70s and 80s icons were the first fake natties: they never admitted steroids to the mainstream, and Arnold shrank between films when off cycle
PED use is cheating, though in pro sports it may not be bad, since if everyone cheats no one is
Natural leagues cannot be policed without reliable testing, so at best they are mostly natural
Natural shows copy pro standards, putting skeletal, depleted naturals on stage at 8 percent body fat; natural bodybuilding must redefine itself
He comments heavily on other channels, including enhanced ones, to grow and to pull their mostly natural viewers away; he usually trolls and has rarely been banned
He comments more on creators who admit PED use, a step better than fake natties
He is straight edge: anti-drugs, anti-alcohol, so the you-drink-too whataboutism does not apply to him
Having standards means living by them without projecting them on others; proselytizing never works, so lead by action
Natural purity tests that shun anyone who engages with enhanced lifters shrink an already small group; naturals must reach into other communities
He welcomes PED users on his channel while hoping they stop
Natural lifting is superior because naturals will live longer
Being natural is a base state with no pride in it if you are small, but staying natural while accomplishing something is worth showing because it is relatable
He is entirely against selling programs and nutrition plans on YouTube Fitness; most sellers are scammers
You cannot save people, only yourself; he walks ahead and lets whoever wants follow
As a child he lied constantly to escape a reality he hated; when he started over in a new environment he vowed never to lie again and has kept it
Nobody can be trusted on YouTube Fitness anymore; a big natural would be accused of TRT, which is part of why natural bodybuilding is dead
Never buy anything he recommends; if he ever sells a paid program, unsubscribe; he will not make a penny from the channel
Blaming society's PED stigma for users' secrecy is intellectually dishonest; users must take responsibility, especially when selling products
Natty-or-not videos only make viewers feel better about being small; they do not help anyone train
Focus on trustworthy natural channels, and unsubscribe from any that betray you, his included
Focus on yourself, your training and your life rather than YouTube heroes
Pledge never to buy a YouTube program or a supplement pushed by a creator; learn to program, use free programs, eat whole foods and train for a long time
He has no issue with someone massive on drugs, only with lying about it
